verses.sanskrit:
दशश्लोकी
न भूमिर्न तोयं न तेजो न वायु
र्न खं नेन्द्रियं वा न तेषां समूहः।
अनेकान्तिकत्वात्सुषुप्त्येकसिद्ध
स्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।1।।
verses.roman:
Daśaślokī
na bhūmirna toyaṃ na tejo na vāyuḥ
na khaṃ nendriyaṃ vā na teṣāṃ samūhaḥ .
anekāntikatvāt suṣuptyekasiddhaḥ
tadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham .. 1..
verses.colloquial:
Dashashlokii..
na bhuumirna toyam na tejo na vaayuh
na kham nendriyam vaa na teshaam samuuhah .
anekaantikatvaat sushuptyekasiddhah
tadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham .. 1..
verses.translation_reworded:
Earth I am not, nor water.
Light I am not, nor wind.
Ether I am not, nor the organs of sense,
and I am no combination of these,
since none of them lasts at all times.
What I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न वर्णा न वर्णाश्रमाचारधर्मा
न मे धारणाध्यानयोगादयोऽपि।
अनात्माश्रयाहं ममाध्यासहाना
त्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।2।।
verses.roman:
Na varṇā na varṇāśramācāradharmā
Na me dhāraṇādhyānayogādayo'pi.
Anātmāśrayāhaṃ mamādhyāsahānā
Ttadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..2..
verses.colloquial:
Na varnaa na varnaashramaachaaradharmaa
Na me dhaaranaadhyaanayogaadayo'pi.
Anaatmaashrayaaham mamaadhyaasahaanaa
Ttadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..2..
verses.translation_reworded:
Caste is not what I am, nor the rules of caste,
nor the stages of life.
Rules and right conduct are not me,
nor meditation, nor the practice of yoga,
since the idea of 'I' and 'me' wipes all of these away.
What I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न माता पिता वा न देवा न लोका
न वेदा न यज्ञा न तीर्थं ब्रुवन्ति।
सुषुप्तौ निरस्तातिशून्यात्मकत्वा
त्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।3।।
verses.roman:
Na mātā pitā vā na devā na lokā
Na vedā na yajñā na tīrthaṃ bruvanti.
Suṣuptau nirastātiśūnyātmakatvā
Ttadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..3..
verses.colloquial:
Na maataa pitaa vaa na devaa na lokaa
Na vedaa na yajnaa na tiirtham bruvanti.
Sushuptau nirastaatishuunyaatmakatvaa
Ttadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..3..
verses.translation_reworded:
In sleep, it is said, there is no mother and no father,
no celestial gods and no earth,
no Vedas and no fire sacrifice,
no holy waters.
Yet sleep is not a void either.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न सांख्यं न शैवं न तत्पाञ्चरात्रं
न जैनं न मीमांसकादेर्मतं वा।
विशिष्टानुभूत्या विशुद्धात्मकत्वा
त्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।4।।
verses.roman:
Na sāṃkhyaṃ na śaivaṃ na tatpāñcarātraṃ
Na jainaṃ na mīmāṃsakādermataṃ vā.
Viśiṣṭānubhūtyā viśuddhātmakatvā
Ttadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..4..
verses.colloquial:
Na saamkhyam na shaivam na tatpaancharaatram
Na jainam na miimaamsakaadermatam vaa.
Vishishtaanubhuutyaa vishuddhaatmakatvaa
Ttadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..4..
verses.translation_reworded:
The Sankhya principle,
the doctrine of Shaiva,
the principle of pancha rathra,
the doctrine of the Jainas,
and the principle of Meemasa:
none of these is a unique experience,
for the soul is the purest truth that is known.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न चोर्ध्वं न चाधो न चान्तर्न बाह्यं
न मध्यं न तिर्यङ् न पूर्वापरा दिक्।
वियद्व्यापकत्वादखण्डैकरूप
स्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।5।।
verses.roman:
Na cordhvaṃ na cādho na cāntarna bāhyaṃ
Na madhyaṃ na tiryaṅ na pūrvāparā dik.
Viyadvyāpakat vādakhaṇḍaikarūpa
Stadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..5..
verses.colloquial:
Na chordhvam na chaadho na chaantarna baahyam
Na madhyam na tiryan na puurvaaparaa dik.
Viyadvyaapakat vaadakhandaikaruupa
Stadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..5..
verses.translation_reworded:
I am not above and not below,
not inside and not outside,
not the middle and not the across,
not the east and not the west,
since I extend everywhere,
like the all-pervading ether.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न शुक्लं न कृष्णं न रक्तं न पीतं
न कुब्जं न पीनं न ह्रस्वं न दीर्घम्।
अरूपं तथा ज्योतिराकारकत्वा
त्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।6।।
verses.roman:
Na śuklaṃ na kṛṣṇaṃ na raktaṃ na pītaṃ
Na kubjaṃ na pīnaṃ na hrasvaṃ na dīrgham.
Arūpaṃ tathā jyotirākārakatvā
Ttadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..6..
verses.colloquial:
Na shuklam na krishnam na raktam na piitam
Na kubjam na piinam na hrasvam na diirgham.
Aruupam tathaa jyotiraakaarakatvaa
Ttadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..6..
verses.translation_reworded:
The soul is not white or black,
not red or yellow,
not large or thin,
not short or tall,
and it has no form,
since its form is light itself.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न शास्ता न शास्त्रं न शिष्यो न शिक्षा
न च त्वं न चाहं न चायं प्रपञ्चः।
स्वरूपावबोधो विकल्पासहिष्णु
स्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।7।।
verses.roman:
Na śāstā na śāstraṃ na śiṣyo na śikṣā
Na ca tvaṃ na cāhaṃ na cāyaṃ prapañcaḥ.
Svarūpāvabodho vikalpāsahiṣṇu
Stadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..7..
verses.colloquial:
Na shaastaa na shaastram na shishyo na shikshaa
Na cha tvam na chaaham na chaayam prapanchah.
Svaruupaavabodho vikalpaasahishnu
Stadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..7..
verses.translation_reworded:
I am not the source of knowledge,
nor the books that hold it,
not the disciple and not the teacher,
not you, not me, and not this world,
since innate realisation will not allow any of this.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न जाग्रन्न मे स्वप्नको वा सुषुप्ति
र्न विश्वो न वा तैजसः प्राज्ञको वा।
अविद्यात्मकत्वात्त्रयाणां तुरीय
स्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।8।।
verses.roman:
Na jāgranna me svapnako vā suṣupti
Rna viśvo na vā taijasaḥ prājñako vā.
Avidyātmakatvāttrayāṇāṃ turīya
Stadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..8..
verses.colloquial:
Na jaagranna me svapnako vaa sushupti
Rna vishvo na vaa taijasah praajnako vaa.
Avidyaatmakatvaattrayaanaam turiiya
Stadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..8..
verses.translation_reworded:
Waking does not belong to me,
nor dreaming,
nor deep sleep.
I am not the feelings of the earthly state,
not the glorified feelings of dreams,
not the feeling of wakefulness in sleep,
for these are the souls of avidya,
and I am the fourth, the thureeya, beyond them all.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
अपि व्यापकत्वाद्धि तत्त्वप्रयोगा
त्स्वतः सिद्धभावादनन्याश्रयत्वात्।
जगत्तुच्छमेतत्समस्तं तदन्य
त्तदेकोऽवशिष्टः शिवः केवलोऽहम्।।9।।
verses.roman:
Api vyāpakatvāddhi tattvaprayogā
Tsvataḥ siddhabhāvādananyāśrayatvāt.
Jagattucchametatsamastaṃ tadanya
Ttadeko'vaśiṣṭaḥ śivaḥ kevalo'ham..9..
verses.colloquial:
Api vyaapakatvaaddhi tattvaprayogaa
Tsvatah siddhabhaavaadananyaashrayatvaat.
Jagattucchametatsamastam tadanya
Ttadeko'vashishtah shivah kevalo'ham..9..
verses.translation_reworded:
It is all-pervasive and goal-oriented,
and it relies on its own nature
rather than on anything outside.
This world, being different from the self, is trivial.
So what I am is Shiva alone, the self.
That is what still remains in sleep,
when everything else has been removed.

verses.sanskrit:
न चैकं तदन्यद्द्वितीयं कुतः स्या
न्न वा केवलत्वं न चाकेवलत्वम्।
न शून्यं न चाशून्यमद्वैतकत्वा
त्कथं सर्ववेदान्तसिद्धं ब्रवीमि।।10।।
verses.roman:
Na caikaṃ tadanyaddvitīyaṃ kutaḥ syā
Nna vā kevalatvaṃ na cākevalatvam.
Na śūnyaṃ na cāśūnyamadvaitakatvā
Tkathaṃ sarvavedāntasiddhaṃ bravīmi..10..
verses.colloquial:
Na chaikam tadanyaddvitiiyam kutah syaa
Nna vaa kevalatvam na chaakevalatvam.
Na shuunyam na chaashuunyamadvaitakatvaa
Tkatham sarvavedaantasiddham braviimi..10..
verses.translation_reworded:
It is not even one, so how could it be two?
It is not unique, and it is not non-unique.
It is not a vacuum, nor anything different from a vacuum,
since it is the very essence of non-dual reality.
So how can I speak of what all philosophy establishes?

verses.sanskrit:
इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्द
भगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छंकरभगवतः कृतौ
दशश्लोकी समाप्ता।।
verses.roman:
Iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovinda
Bhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṃkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau
Daśaślokī samāptā..
verses.colloquial:
Iti shriimatparamahamsaparivraajakaachaaryasya shriigovinda
Bhagavatpuujyapaadashishyasya shriimacchamkarabhagavatah kritau
Dashashlokii samaaptaa..
